# #27 Templates: blind adversarial QA

**Verdict: PASS for #27 itself, with one dependency defect (D1, major) that is outside #27's code.** The seeds do not render styled because #16 is not in this base.

**Method.** I tested blind, without reading the diff, `src/` or `server/`. I used three throwaway backends from `scripts/lib/stack.sh`, pinned with `MDREVIEW_NOW` to 2026-10-10T20Z, 2026-12-31T12Z and 2027-01-01T12Z. Browser runs used `stack.sh run` (prod build) inside the lane flock and `browser-slot.sh`, one Chromium at a time.

**Drivers** are in `.verify/qa/27/`:
- `api.mjs` + `run-api.sh`: REST, plus MCP over stdio and HTTP through the `23-helpers.mjs` launchers.
- `ui.mjs` (phases core / save / tab / visual), `dbg.mjs` and `dbg2.mjs`.

**Results** are in `.verify/qa/27/api-results.txt`, `ui-results.txt` and `dbg2.out`.

## Edge cases (all PASS unless noted)
- **Placeholders:**
  - A placeholder split across lines, `{{title}` (unclosed), `{{ }}`, `{{1abc}}`, mermaid `A{{Decide}}` and `{{Title}}` (case) are all left unchanged.
  - In `{{{title}}}` only the inner placeholder is replaced, giving `{T}`.
  - Code spans are substituted.
- **Special characters in the title:** `$& $1 $$ \ \1 .* $\` $'` is inserted literally. This holds over the API and in the picker preview (`R $& $1 \ .* ok`, slug `r-1-ok`).
- **Timezone and ISO week:**
  - `Not/AZone` falls back to UTC (200).
  - 2026-12-31 gives `2026-W53`, and 2027-01-01 also gives `2026-W53`.
  - Pacific/Kiritimati at 2026-12-31T12Z gives 2027-01-01 and W53.
- **Deleted collections:**
  - Instantiating with a deleted `collectionId` returns 400 `unknown_collection` and creates nothing.
  - If a template's default collection is deleted, the template reads `collectionId:null` and the picker shows Unfiled. Creating from it works (`/d/doomed-child`); screenshot `qa-picker-deleted-collection.png`.
- **Save as template, special docs:**
  - An html doc gets `{{title}}` in `<title>` and in the first `<h1>`; the second `<h1>` is untouched.
  - A doc with no heading is saved unchanged.
  - A doc over 1 MB shows "This document is larger than 1 MB, the limit for a template." (`qa-save-1mb.png`).
- **Name rules:** case-only and whitespace-only name clashes return 409 over the API. A builtin name returns 409 even with `replace:true`. Renaming a user template to a builtin name shows an error in the UI.
- **Validation limits:** 400 for a name over 80 chars, a description over 280, more than 20 variables, a variable over 500 chars, and a title that is empty or over 200 chars.
- **Offline create:** the picker stays open with title and author intact, the URL is unchanged, and an error toast appears (`qa-offline-create.png`).
- **Keyboard:**
  - Opening the picker by Enter on the trigger moves focus inside it.
  - Focus stays trapped over 25 Tabs.
  - Enter on an item selects it, and Enter in the title submits.
  - Esc closes the picker and focus returns to `landing-new-from-template`.
  - The save dialog traps focus, submits on Enter and closes on Esc.
- **Menu visibility:** `doc-save-as-template` is absent on the file route `/d/<id>/notes.md` and on the pinned revision `/d/<id>@<hash>` (banner present). It is present for a viewer who holds no token.
- **Picker filter:** it appears when there are more than 8 templates (11 or 14 in my runs) and narrows to one result.
- **Themes:** in all 6 themes the picker, save dialog and Templates tab look correct (`qa-theme-<theme>-{picker,save,tab}.png`). I looked at locus-dark picker, github-dark save and dark tab: contrast and borders are fine.
- **Console:** no page errors in any run.

## Defects
1. **D1 (major, dependency): seeds render unstyled.** `> [!NOTE]` / `[!WARNING]` / `[!IMPORTANT]` show as plain blockquotes with the literal `[!NOTE]` text, and `:rag-green[On track]` shows as raw text. This happens both in the created doc and in `template-preview`.
   - Repro: create from Weekly leadership update, then open `/d/<slug>?view=read`.
   - Screenshots: `qa-seed-weekly-rendered.png`, `qa-picker-form-desktop.png`, `qa-theme-locus-dark-picker.png`.
   - Cause: `docs/build/LANDED` does not include #16, while the spec says "#16 lands before this item, so seeds render styled".
   - Action: land #16 before #27, or re-check this after #16 lands. It is not a defect in #27's own code.
2. **D2 (cosmetic): the clash error quotes the typed name, not the existing template's name.** For example it says `A template named "incident REVIEW" already exists` when the existing template is "Incident review". Confirming Replace also renames the template to the typed casing. That is arguably within "replaces that template's content and fields", but it surprises.
3. **D3 (cosmetic): heading anchor icons in the preview.** Headings inside `template-preview` show the anchor-link icon (`qa-phone-form-btn.png`, `qa-picker-form-desktop.png`). It is noise inside a preview.
4. **Note (not a defect): `variables` includes unknown valid names.** For example `Decide` comes from mermaid `A{{Decide}}`, which matches spec rule 8 literally. The picker would show it as a variable chip.

## Test-driver notes (no product impact)
- `editUrl` opens the read view; the edit view needs `view-toggle-edit`.
- `template-delete-confirm` is the dialog container (a DIV), not the button. The first "deleted from list" FAIL came from my driver clicking the container; `dbg2.mjs` confirmed that delete works.
